LESSON: JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early
Topic 3.2: Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Jesus Christ. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how Jesus Christ obeyed his the temple?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. desire to follow Jesus  Learners to sequentially arrange flash cards Christ’s example by accompanying their parentsleft in the temple to church

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. desire to follow Jesus  Learners to sequentially arrange flash cards Christ’s example by accompanying their parentsleft in the temple to church
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to follow Jesus  Learners to sequentially arrange flash cards Christ’s example by accompanying their parentsleft in the temple to church. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Jesus Christ.
2. Explain Jesus Christ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should mention incidences of baptism they 1. In
4. Show that you can: desire to follow Jesus  Learners to sequentially arrange flash cards Christ’s example by accompanying their parentsleft in the temple to church
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Jesus Christ. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how Jesus Christ obeyed his the temple?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
